note: Hand-written. Every entry names the file in this repository that proves it is used. Nothing here is inferred from the ingested lists, because no list on GitHub knows what anyone uses. `catalogue` links to a slug in tools.json when the ingested lists happen to carry the same tool; most of the load-bearing ones they do not.

vocabulary.builds: In the dependency graph or the deploy path of this site. Removing it breaks the build.
vocabulary.checks: Runs in CI against every push. Removing it loses a guarantee the site makes in public.
vocabulary.serves: Runs in production, on the request path of a real visitor.

pending: Depth of use across the owner's wider work is not recorded yet. The vocabulary above describes this repository only, which is the part that can be checked by reading it.

star.meaning: A star means the tool is used to build, check or serve this site, and the row names the file that proves it. It is not a quality rating.
star.extraNote: Slugs from the catalogue may be starred here, but each one needs a written reason and that reason is printed next to the star. An entry without a reason fails the build.

used.name: Astro
used.note: Static output only. No island is hydrated, because the reading path ships zero bytes of JavaScript.

used.name: Zod
used.note: The schema is the editorial policy. A paper without retirement conditions fails the build rather than shipping quietly.

used.name: Node.js
used.evidence: package.json engines, every script in scripts/

used.name: Playwright
used.note: Fourteen viewports, both sides of every breakpoint. Added after a phone rendered 517 pixels of content inside 375.

used.name: pa11y
used.note: Runs axe. Caught four keyboard traps the day the figures were repaired.

used.name: GitHub Actions
used.note: Every gate runs with if: !cancelled(), because a job that stops at the first failure was hiding the checks behind it.

used.name: Cloudflare D1
used.note: Holds the rate-limit and token state behind the CV gate. Nothing else on the site touches a database.

used.name: Wrangler
used.note: Called directly rather than through an action wrapper: one fewer third party in the release path.

used.name: Resend
used.note: Sends the single-use CV link. The only outbound mail this site sends.

used.name: Git
used.evidence: scripts/check-revised.mjs reads commit dates to verify every note's revised field
